wikiGeography.regionSummary: Tirannwn is the geographical elven region west of Kandarin on the western edge of Gielinor. Isolated forest realm; access after starting Regicide (base game). Capital is Prifddinas after Plague's End. Welsh-themed naming throughout.

canonicalSubregions.name: Prifddinas

promotionalCollapse.interpretation: Equilibrium marketing collapses Tirannwn to its two marquee destinations (Prifddinas city + Lost Grove island). That is a highlight list, not a claim that Isafdar/Lletya/Tyras/Poison Waste leave the region. Auto-completed quests for the region are expected to open the full elven-lands package, with Prif called out as the immediate payoff.

catalystContext.note: Catalyst League was not region-locked; Plague's End and the elf quest chain were among global auto-completions. Equilibrium introduces elective region unlocking; Tirannwn is one of eight elective regions (plus starting Misthalin/Havenhythe and automatic-early Karamja).

findings.title: Prifddinas is a city/sub-area, not the region
findings.detail: Wiki: Prifddinas is the capital city of Tirannwn. Catalog correctly uses region id tirannwn. Map/UI must never treat Prifddinas as a selectable League region.

findings.title: Bare name Prifddinas collides across areas, content, and upgrades
findings.detail: areas[] has Prifddinas; content[0].name is Prifddinas (kind high-level hub); upgrades[0].name is Prifddinas (category major high-level hub). Role-specific titles are required for content/upgrade rows.

findings.title: League promo intentionally highlights only Prif + Lost Grove
findings.detail: Jagex Equilibrium news only names those two for Tirannwn. Catalog areas[] match that promo. This is League-aware collapse, not a wiki error.

findings.title: Wiki geography is much larger than areas[]
findings.detail: Tirannwn page subregions: Prifddinas, Isafdar, Arandar. Places of interest also include Lletya, Tyras Camp, Elf Camp, Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon, Arposandra. None of Isafdar/Lletya/Tyras/Arandar/Poison Waste appear in areas[] or placeAnchors.

findings.title: Lost Grove is an island west of Tirannwn, not a city district
findings.detail: Wiki places it in the Western Sea / west of Tirannwn. Equilibrium still assigns 'access to the Lost Grove' under the Tirannwn region pick. Catalog placing Lost Grove as a Tirannwn area is League-correct.

findings.title: Lost Grove article vs area label
findings.detail: Wiki and content use The Lost Grove; areas[] and placeAnchors use Lost Grove. Prefer one display form; keep areas[] stable for anchors.

findings.title: Empty hardRules/warnings on Tirannwn

findings.title: Deep catalog upgrades already encode Prif district surface

verdict.summary: Tirannwn is the region; Prifddinas is its capital city (dense hub), not a region pick. Catalog areas correctly mirror Equilibrium's two marquee examples (Prifddinas + Lost Grove) while wiki geography also includes Isafdar, Arandar, Lletya, Tyras/Port Tyras, Poison Waste, and more. Prefer keeping Prifddinas and Lost Grove as areas; rename content/upgrade bare Prifddinas strings to role-specific titles; optionally add Lletya (and possibly Isafdar) if the map should show more of the elven lands; document Lost Grove as Tirannwn League content despite being an island west of the mainland.
